description: Installation of 1No. BT Street Hub Unit and associated advertisement panels on either side of the unit
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f03b08b7-7fff-e8ce-7e46-31a008f7bf12"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed BT Streethub with digital display, by reason of its inappropriate scale, appearance and location, would comprise an incongruous, overbearing and discordant feature that would contribute to an unsightly proliferation and clutter of furniture in the local area, to the detriment of the visual amenity of the street scene and harm the setting of the Grade II* Listed The Hackney Empire, Grade II Listed Hackney Town Hall and the character and appearance of the Town Hall Square Conservation Area. As such, the proposal would be contrary to policies D3 (Optimising Site Capacity through the Design-led Approach) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (Design quality and local character) and LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of Hackney's Local Development Plan (2020).</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6a380979-7fff-5782-ab11-fc55dcd633bf"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed BT Streethub with digital display, by reason of its scale, appearance, location would result in an obstructive and intrusive form of development that would obstruct the pavement, reduce the amount of space available for use by pedestrians, block lines of sight creating blind spots and create distractions for highway users thereby reducing the safety of the highway. As such the proposed development is contrary to policy D8 (Public Realm), T2 (Healthy Streets), </span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">T4 (Assessing and Mitigating Transport Impacts)</span><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;"> of the London Plan (2021) as well as policies PP1 (Public Realm), LP41 (Liveable Neighbourhoods) and LP42 (Walking and Cycling), LP43 (Transport and Development) of the Hackney Local Plan.</span></span></p><div><br></div>
